summary: This class method queries a database table to retrieve notes associated with a specific piece of content. It builds a SQL query to fetch the 'note' column from the ratings table where the content ID is 8, executes the query, and returns all the results as an array.

explanations.7: getQuery(true) creates a new database query object; the 'true' parameter tells it to use the database driver's query syntax instead of generic SQL.
explanations.8: select() specifies which columns you want the database to return — in this case just the 'note' column.
explanations.9: from() tells the database which table to look in; the '#__' is a placeholder that gets replaced with the actual table prefix when the query runs.
explanations.10: where() adds a condition that filters results to only rows where the content_id equals 8.
explanations.13: loadColumn() executes the query and returns just the values from that one selected column as a simple array, rather than returning full row objects.
